Hong Kong watched mainland gold chains cut prices for Golden Week — and footfall doubled.

Chow Sang Sang quoted 1,249 yuan a gram on 2 October, Chow Tai Fook 1,255, Lao Miao 1,252 — over 10% below August highs. A Changsha store reported footfall doubling as buyers bought wedding sets.

香港業界關注：周生生、周大福、老廟三大內地金飾品牌國慶黃金周齊齊減價，較8月下旬高位跌逾一成。長沙一家門店首日客流倍增，顧客組隊購買婚嫁金飾；鄭州、杭州金飾櫃台同日金價同步走低。

Full story on caratcapital.org, link in bio.
